attributes.action: Ban the barbaric killing of animals to produce Halal meats in UK.
attributes.additional_details: Animal killed for Halal meat have their throats cut and left to bleed out and die. A most barbaric way in this day and age.
attributes.background: Ban Halal process and ensure all animals are killed in the most humanely way possible.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

End the religious slaughter exemption and require irreversible stunning
